notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 26 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer226cont), the weekly issues from 3 July to 31 December 1926 (the last two came out on Fridays). Same method as vol. 26 part 1: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1925-1928, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1926. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; about 190 of the 306 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. In this item the reader's page index and the scan leaf drift apart (index 233 is leaf 236), so the image for a citation is fetched through the item's leaf map.

coverage.remaining: Vol. 26 parts 1 and 2 read; the other 32 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 27 part 1 (buildingengineer227cont, January-June 1927) next. In this volume: 425 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 586 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside 1925-1928). 946 rows were not placed: 435 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 270 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets), 239 printed street numbers with no EAS row today, and 2 ambiguous.
coverage.note: 3,765 numbered entries read, 2,264 San Francisco rows, 1,318 placed on a parcel, 306 picked and read against the page image, 290 published on 282 pages (186 seeded), 17 held back at the image check (repeat listings, same-issue contracts merged into the permit entry, uses that contradict the roll, one misread number).
